entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Building a new library fails with NU1101 during restore of itself #120582
  • Generating VisualStudio project does not work after updating to VS 2026 #120578
  • Assert Interop.Sys.LSeek(this, 0, Interop.Sys.SeekWhence.SEEK_CUR) >= 0 in System.Net.XXX tests #120577
  • Authentication failures in Power BI Gateway and SharePoint connections after Windows Update + .NET Framework patch #120576
  • Users have found that the string.IndexOf(string) method in .net 9 behaves incorrectly when searching for special characters or punctuation (such as commas ","), particularly when no explicit String Comparison method is specified. #120568
  • [API Proposal]: Expand X509Certificate2 to support Post Quantum Crypto #120565
  • ReflectionXmlSerializationWriter throws NullReferenceException when base class contains "ShouldSerialize" methods #120561
  • Test failure: Interop/Swift/SwiftCallbackAbiStress/SwiftCallbackAbiStress/SwiftCallbackAbiStress.cmd #120557
